issues.problem: The word is traiṣṭubham (neuter, the sāman/chant of the triṣṭubh), not the metre name; the English changes the word and the notes call both 'metre names', an interpretation.
Keep the gloss on the printed word, as for gāyatram.
śakunti is feminine (unit 042.3 labels śakunte f.); 'm.' is inconsistent.
vadanta is not a present middle (that would be vadante): it is the -anta (injunctive/imperfect-type) form; label accordingly.
'यज्ञ के' is added; English 'at the pressings' (savana = pressing).

issues.problem: 'मादाओं' (females) is an addition; English has 'those with young'.
'bahuvrīhi' is the wrong label: śiśumatī is a possessive derivative in -mant, not a compound.

Hindi 'ब्रह्मा के पुत्र' reads as the son of the god Brahmā; English says 'a Brahman'. Glossary has Brahman priest = ब्रह्मा, but the notes call the sense uncertain. Align Hindi, English and notes on one reading.

issues.problem: 'तब' (then) is added; the last two pādas are loosely joined and the notes say so.
Hindi refrain adds the noun 'वचन' (words) that is not in bṛhad vadema; 'speak greatly' has no object.

summary: Reviewed 3 units. Total issues: 0 error, 16 minor. No clear errors; all minor: glossary deviations (vājin = prize-winner, sumati = favour), traiṣṭubha rendered as 'triṣṭubh', śakunti gender, śiśumatī mislabelled bahuvrīhi, Hindi additions (यज्ञ के, मादाओं, तब, refrain 'वचन'), brahmaputra Hindi 'ब्रह्मा के पुत्र' unclear. Confidence 'low' on all three units is honest. Unit 2 has three printed lines; no regrouping suggested.
